name: p1-static
cmd: set -eu; bun install --frozen-lockfile; bunx tsc -p research/bapa/tsconfig.p1.json; bunx oxlint --type-aware --deny-warnings --disable-nested-config research/protocols/ic3syn/models.ts research/protocols/ic3syn/sized-p1.test.ts research/bapa/lock-server-sized.test.ts; bun test research/protocols/ic3syn/sized-p1.test.ts research/bapa/lock-server-sized.test.ts; bun research/protocols/ic3syn/check.ts --only lock_server,lockserv,lockserv_automaton,simple_decentralized_lock,simple,simple_regular,simple_election,firewall --edges > "$SUPERCOMPUTER_OUTPUT_DIR/port.jsonl"; bun research/protocols/ic3syn/check.ts --only lock_server,lockserv,lockserv_automaton,simple_decentralized_lock,simple,simple_regular,simple_election,firewall --broken > "$SUPERCOMPUTER_OUTPUT_DIR/broken.jsonl"
